description: This file defines interfaces and extension methods related to grain storage serializers in Orleans. It includes the main 'IGrainStorageSerializer' interface, extension methods for it, options interfaces, and a default configurator class for serializer options.

classes.name: IGrainStorageSerializer
classes.description: Interface for serializing and deserializing grain state objects.

classes.name: GrainStorageSerializerExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for the IGrainStorageSerializer interface.

classes.name: IStorageProviderSerializerOptions
classes.description: Interface for options related to storage provider serializer configuration.

classes.name: DefaultStorageProviderSerializerOptionsConfigurator`1
classes.description: Class that implements post-configuration for storage provider serializer options, setting default serializer if none is set.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes an object to a BinaryData.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes BinaryData back into an object of type T.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Extension method that deserializes a ReadOnlyMemory<byte> into an object of type T.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Configures the options after they are initially set, assigning a default serializer if none is provided.
